notes.title: Get Revive & Prosper Full game with 20 % off
notes.content:
[h1]First of all, thank you for your interest in Revive & Prosper: Prologue! [/h1]

[h3]The Prologue is like dipping a toe into an ocean of automation.[/h3] 
It shows you the [b]very beginning of the game[/b] and the basic controls. It even lets you [b]meet the Martian enemies[/b] that you can turn on or off in the full game.

Here you can see what the dealing with Martian enemies look like:

[previewyoutube=uWeckJxwRas;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247760/Revive__Prosper/?utm_source=prologueupdate]Revive & Prosper[/url] is a complex yet not difficult automation game[/h2] 
You can spend [b]hours planning and building your base[/b] in the chill, sandbox-style Builder mode.

Check a short gameplay here:

[previewyoutube=cVPM-eHMw6E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]If you enjoy more challenging gameplay,[/h2]
choose between [b]Survivor or Battler[/b] modes with [b]environmental disasters[/b] such as heat bursts and fire, where you need to focus more on [b]taking care[/b] of your mutant crew’s needs.

For each difficulty, you can choose to play [b]with or without Martian enemies[/b], who bring the need for either diplomacy or intergalactic combat with [b]tower defense elements[/b].

[h2]The key to your efficiency is smart water control. [/h2]
It is a source of [b]moisture for vegetation[/b], power for your factories, and even a weapon against aggressive Martian flora.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/59f8be18d328a4c98f9b596c20a7fad3db5bd516.jpg[/img]

[h2]Last but not least, the strength of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247760/Revive__Prosper/?utm_source=prologueupdate]Revive & Prosper[/url] lies in the infinite number of ways you can solve problems.[/h2]
[list]
[*] Not enough space for factories? [b]Shape the terrain[/b], first manually, then automatically with a soil cannon.
[*] Not enough moisture for your fields? Bring water [b]through pipes[/b] and spread it with sprinklers.
[*] Heat burst causing water sources to dry up? Store water in [b]liquid tanks[/b].
[*] Not enough wind for your windmills? [b]Build an atomic plant[/b] to produce enough power for the whole base.
[/list]

[h2]Take advantage of this limited offer to get the humble automation game with surprising depth. [/h2]
The best part is that the many [b]excellent features are still coming[/b]! 

As you can see, the game is in Early Access but is [b]continuously updated[/b], with the full release planned for fall of this year, when the price will increase slightly.

[h2]Don't miss the opportunity to grab such a bargain![/h2]

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247760/Revive__Prosper/?utm_source=prologueupdate]Get the full game here[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Update 2 - GOLEMS
notes.content:
[h1]Update 2 - GOLEMS is OUT![/h1]

[h2]A massive update for Revive & Prosper is here, making your gameplay even smoother and more efficient! 
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/1cf8b886c9f6a2771534e0d28bfe0322d59286bc.gif[/img]

[h2]Here's what's new:[/h2]

[h3]Introducing 3 New Golems:[/h3]

[b]Stone Golem:[/b] With a 72-hour lifespan, this golem excels underwater and boasts the highest bonuses for planting and harvesting. Spawn it using stone and wood.

[b]Metal Golem:[/b] A true beast with a shiny look but a heavy metal heart inside and a 120-hour lifespan. Crafted from iron ingots and coal, it offers unmatched strength.

[b]High-Tech Golem:[/b] The pinnacle of golem technology, with a 144-hour lifespan. It works underwater and carries loads of resources, representing the height of efficiency and capability.
For a deeper dive into the golem updates, check out our pre-release post: [url=https://reviveandprosper.com/golems-update/]Revive & Prosper Golem Update[/url].

Check out the beautifiul resources you'll be gathering for creating your side-kicks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/a82cf13d24fe907aa53dd768150212e94479ffa5.jpg[/img]

[h3]One-Click Belt Upgrades![/h3]
Upgrading your belts is now as simple as a click. Upgrade individual belts or entire lines effortlessly,  just click on the wooden belt and then on the [b]Upgrade[/b] button in the right window. 
To upgrade a whole line, simply select metal belts in the build menu and then mark the line of wooden belts with the selected metal belts. And your characters will do the rest.

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Golems and mutants can now level up their skills, supercharging their efficiency in harvesting, digging, and building. Get ready to expand your bases faster than ever!
[*] To keep your golems at peak performance, recharge them in the new [b]Golem Recharger[/b] building. Just keep an eye on your biomass supply!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/e6307740affffc94cc2bde47c22e1838d662d617.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/3549c159a6d902a4026a2a9b3e2f2f2febb26b2e.gif[/img]

[h3]Balancing & Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Resources from the lowest levels and limestone have been rebalanced for a smoother gameplay experience.
[*] Chemical plants now require a maximum of 2 liquids for production, streamlining your manufacturing processes.
[*] The beloved blue sky has returned, enhancing the cozy and neat atmosphere of Revive & Prosper's world.
[*] Tutorial improvements to eliminate common errors.
[*] Fixes for building dams and ensuring electric power nets connect properly.
[*] Resolved issues with fertilizers becoming toxic, teleporters causing crashes, natural tree spreading, and game crashes related to job assignments.
[/list]

And now, hurry to build an epic base!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/c2951da23c971fa67e69376d360e0be7cd913056.gif[/img]

[b]Team Revive & Prosper wishes you happy gaming! 🌱[/b]
